scope.description: Per-operation response correlation for released forwarded requests within a stable leader term and membership after a current-term entry is committed.
assumptions: Distinct nonzero SystemCtx values identify independently admitted requests.
Requests and quorum acknowledgements originate from the actual Peer handlers in one controlled history.
Non-Byzantine members; a delayed earlier response may overlap later traffic; no crash or membership change during the selected history.
excluded: No requirement that unconfirmed or dropped requests succeed.
No deadline or infinite-stall claim; no end-to-end NodeHost completion or stale-read consequence.
No backend crash atomicity or snapshot-recovery property.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Replace transport with a deterministic queue delivering actual generated messages.
Use existing volatile TestLogDB instead of production disk backend, with no crash/restart.
Synchronously consume committed bootstrap and noop entries; no application query or NodeHost endpoint is measured.
Read private state only to verify setup/admission and report pending-count diagnostics.

plan_uncertainties: Peer-level identity check does not measure NodeHost request timeout, application lookup, or whole-cluster linearizability.
Undelivered earlier heartbeat traffic remains explicitly delayed; no lost automatic-continuation claim is inferred.
